svg.title: How scrapeplanner decides: the method ladder
svg.desc: Five methods from cheapest to most expensive: feed or API, structured data, embedded JSON, HTML, headless browser. The first one that works is recommended. Counts are the recommended method per site in run 008-sites: Feed / API 5, Structured data 3, Embedded JSON 2, HTML 13, Browser 1; 6 of 30 sites were not a fit.
svg.text: Cheapest first. The first rung that works wins.
CSS selectors on the raw page
6 of 30 not a fit: blocked, challenged or disallowed
Counts: best method per site, run 008-sites
